mcqs.question: S K M Maeilanandhan received the Padma Bhushan 2026 for which field?
mcqs.explanation: S K M Maeilanandhan received the Padma Bhushan for Social Work. Public Affairs is associated with several other awardees, but not with this recipient.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements regarding Shatavadhani R Ganesh is incorrect?
options: He was a Padma Bhushan awardee in 2026.
His name is Shatavadhani R Ganesh.
He was honoured in the field of Art.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that Shatavadhani R Ganesh was associated with Kerala; his State was Karnataka. He was a Padma Bhushan awardee in the field of Art.

mcqs.question: Shibu Soren, a posthumous Padma Bhushan awardee in 2026, was associated with which State?
mcqs.explanation: Shibu Soren was a posthumous Padma Bhushan awardee associated with Jharkhand. Kerala and Maharashtra were associated with other Padma Bhushan awardees.

mcqs.question: Uday Kotak received the Padma Bhushan 2026 in which field?
mcqs.explanation: Uday Kotak received the Padma Bhushan for Trade & Industry. The other options are fields associated with different awardees in the Padma Awards 2026.

mcqs.question: V K Malhotra, a posthumous Padma Bhushan awardee in 2026, was associated with which place?
mcqs.explanation: V K Malhotra was a posthumous Padma Bhushan awardee associated with Delhi. Jharkhand, Karnataka and Uttarakhand correspond to other awardee profiles.

mcqs.question: Vellappally Natesan received the Padma Bhushan 2026 from which State?
mcqs.explanation: Vellappally Natesan was associated with Kerala. Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra and Punjab are not the State associated with this awardee.

mcqs.question: Vijay Amritraj received the Padma Bhushan 2026 for which field?
mcqs.explanation: Vijay Amritraj received the Padma Bhushan for Sports. Art, Public Affairs and Trade & Industry were fields of other Padma Bhushan awardees.

mcqs.question: Gadde Babu Rajendra Prasad, a Padma Shri awardee in the field of Art, was associated with which State?
mcqs.explanation: Gadde Babu Rajendra Prasad received the Padma Shri for Art from Andhra Pradesh. Telangana, Punjab and Rajasthan were associated with other awardees.

mcqs.question: Which status applied to Garimella Balakrishna Prasad in the Padma Awards 2026?
options: Living Padma Shri awardee from Punjab
mcqs.explanation: Garimella Balakrishna Prasad was a posthumous Padma Shri awardee in the field of Art from Andhra Pradesh. The other descriptions do not match his award profile.

mcqs.question:
Match the following Padma Shri sports awardees of 2026 with their States:

List-I
(a) Baldev Singh
(b) Bhagwandas Raikwar
(c) K Pajanivel
(d) Vladimer Mestvirishvili

List-II
(i) Georgia
(ii) Madhya Pradesh
(iii) Puducherry
(iv) Punjab
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Baldev Singh—Punjab, Bhagwandas Raikwar—Madhya Pradesh, K Pajanivel—Puducherry and Vladimer Mestvirishvili—Georgia. Therefore, the correct code is a-iv, b-ii, c-iii, d-i.

mcqs.question:
Match the following Padma Shri awardees of 2026 with their fields and States/Countries:

List-I
(a) Padma Gurmet
(b) Budhri Tati
(c) Buddha Rashmi Mani and Narayan Vyas
(d) Ramamurthy Sreedher

List-II
(i) Radio Broadcasting—Delhi
(ii) Medicine—Ladakh
(iii) Archaeology—Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh
(iv) Social Work—Chhattisgarh
mcqs.explanation: The correct pairs are Padma Gurmet—Medicine, Ladakh; Budhri Tati—Social Work, Chhattisgarh; Buddha Rashmi Mani and Narayan Vyas—Archaeology, Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh; and Ramamurthy Sreedher—Radio Broadcasting, Delhi. Hence, a-ii, b-iv, c-iii, d-i is correct.

mcqs.question: Sivasankari received the Padma Shri 2026 in which field?
mcqs.explanation: Sivasankari received the Padma Shri for Literature & Education from Tamil Nadu. Art, Medicine and Social Work were associated with other awardees.

mcqs.question:
Consider the following statements:

Statement A: Article 18(1) provides that no titles shall be conferred except military and academic distinctions.
Statement B: In Balaji Raghavan v. Union of India (1996), the Supreme Court held that national awards are not titles and cannot be used as prefixes or suffixes.
options: Both Statement A and Statement B are true
Both Statement A and Statement B are false
Statement A is true, Statement B is false
Statement A is false, Statement B is true
mcqs.explanation: Both statements are true. Article 18(1) permits only military and academic distinctions as exceptions, while Balaji Raghavan v. Union of India (1996) held that national awards are not titles and cannot be used as prefixes or suffixes.

mcqs.question: In which year were the Padma Awards instituted?
mcqs.explanation: The Padma Awards were instituted in 1954. The years 1977–80 and 1992–95 refer to periods when the awards were suspended, not to their institution.
